metadata.description: Personal Agent Skills library — spec-conformant, versioned per-plugin, distributed as a Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: pickup-handoff
plugins.description: Session-bracket companions for Claude Code. /pickup hydrates context at the start of a session (reads HANDOFF.md, surfaces open PRs, git state, and recent compound-engineering artifacts if present). /handoff serializes session state at the end (writes a structured HANDOFF.md with what was built, decisions made, what's next, and gotchas).

plugins.name: tmux-window-namer
plugins.description: Style tmux windows with a glyph, a title, and a palette glyph-color, persisted across tmux server restarts via a JSON sidecar. Depends on the dotfiles-installed tmux persistence scripts and client-attached hook; preflight-checks for them and bails cleanly when absent.

plugins.name: review-claudemd
plugins.description: Mine recent conversation history to improve CLAUDE.md — launches parallel subagents to compare what actually happened against the global and local CLAUDE.md, then surfaces violated rules, missing patterns (scoped local vs global), and stale entries. Presents findings for approval and applies only what you accept; never auto-commits. A compounding loop that keeps CLAUDE.md honest as habits evolve.
